en.name: Firm tofu
en.summary: Firm tofu is the dense, water-packed block pressed in cloth, sold loose from a tub or in a sealed tray. Refrigerated at 10 °C or below it keeps about 2–3 days — loose market tofu at the shorter end, packaged at the longer — and it can be frozen, which deliberately changes its texture into the spongy 凍豆腐 many dishes call for.
en.pantry: Fresh tofu is a high-moisture, low-acid, low-salt food, which makes it one of the most perishable things in a vegetarian kitchen. It should not be left at room temperature at all; guidance in Taiwan puts the outside limit at about four hours out of the fridge, and the ordinary two-hour rule (one hour above 32 °C / 90 °F) is the safer habit. Buy it last, carry it home cold, and refrigerate it immediately.
en.fridge: Keep firm tofu submerged in clean cold water in a lidded box and change the water every day; the water keeps the block hydrated and stops the cut surfaces drying and souring. Industry guidance sets the chiller at 10 °C or below, but a domestic fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below is better still, and food-safety advice for fresh tofu specifically calls for 4 °C or below. Loose tofu from a market stall is best eaten the day you buy it and within two days at the outside; a sealed pack keeps to roughly three days, or to its printed date while unopened.
en.freezer: Freezing works, but as a transformation rather than as preservation. Drain the block, press out water under a weight for 20–30 minutes, cut it into cubes and freeze in a sealed bag at −18 °C (0 °F); the ice crystals open the curd into a honeycomb that soaks up broth, which is exactly the point of 凍豆腐 in hotpot and braises. About five months is a reasonable working limit for quality — that figure is borrowed from the general timeline for tofu rather than published for cotton tofu itself, so treat it as guidance, not a documented limit.
en.thawing: Thaw frozen tofu overnight in the fridge, or drop the cubes straight into a simmering soup or braise from frozen. Squeeze out the water that runs from thawed tofu before frying it, or it will spit in the pan.
spoilage: A sour or sharply fermented smell when you lift the lid
Slimy or slippery surfaces, and water that has gone cloudy or ropy
Colour turned from clean white to yellow, grey or pink
Any mould, or a block that has started to fall apart at the edges
tips: Change the storage water daily — it is the single biggest thing you can do.
Buy loose market tofu on the day you plan to cook it.
Press it before frying; a drier block browns instead of steaming.
Freeze in cubes rather than as a whole block so it thaws and takes up flavour evenly.

faq.q: How long does firm tofu last in the fridge?
faq.a: Roughly 2–3 days, submerged in clean cold water that you change daily. Loose market tofu is best eaten the day you buy it; a sealed pack keeps to its printed date while unopened.

Yes, and it is done on purpose to make 凍豆腐. Press, cube and freeze at −18 °C (0 °F). Around five months is a sensible quality limit, borrowed from the general tofu figure rather than published for this type.

faq.q: Why does tofu come sitting in water?
faq.a: The water keeps the block hydrated and keeps air off the cut surfaces. Discarding it and storing tofu dry makes it sour and crack much faster.

faq.q: Does tofu need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Fresh tofu does, and at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. Shelf-stable aseptic packs are a different product and only need refrigerating once opened.

zh.name: 板豆腐
zh.summary: 板豆腐是用布包壓製、質地扎實的含水豆腐，市場散裝或超市盒裝都有。冷藏在 10°C 以下大約可放 2～3 天，市場散裝的偏短、盒裝的偏長；它也可以冷凍，而且冷凍後會變成蜂窩狀的凍豆腐，那正是許多料理要的口感。
zh.pantry: 新鮮豆腐含水量高、酸度低、鹽分也低，是素食廚房裡最容易壞的食材之一。它完全不適合放室溫；國內的建議是離開冷藏最多不要超過四小時，而一般的兩小時原則（氣溫超過 32°C 時只有一小時）是更安全的習慣。採買時最後才拿，全程保冷，回家立刻冷藏。
zh.fridge: 請把板豆腐泡在乾淨冷水裡、裝進有蓋保鮮盒，每天換一次水；水能讓豆腐保持含水狀態，也避免切面乾掉發酸。業界的衛生管理標準是冷藏庫 10°C 以下，但家用冰箱維持在 4°C 以下更好，食品安全單位針對新鮮豆腐也明確建議 4°C 以下。市場散裝豆腐最好當天吃完，最多不要超過兩天；盒裝的大約三天，未開封則以包裝上印的日期為準。
zh.freezer: 冷凍是可行的，但它比較像是「變化質地」而不是「延長保存」。把豆腐瀝乾，壓上重物去水 20～30 分鐘，切塊後裝密封袋放 −18°C；冰晶會把豆腐撐成蜂窩狀，非常吸湯汁，這就是火鍋和滷味裡凍豆腐的由來。品質上大約以五個月為合理的參考上限——這個數字是比照一般豆腐的時程來看，並不是針對板豆腐公布的數據，請當作參考而非定論。
zh.thawing: 解凍請放冷藏室退冰一晚，或直接把冷凍豆腐塊丟進滾湯、滷汁裡煮。解凍後如果要煎炸，先把水分擠乾，否則下鍋會噴油。
spoilage: 打開盒蓋就聞到酸味或明顯的發酵味
表面黏滑，泡的水變混濁或牽絲
顏色從潔白轉為發黃、發灰或泛粉紅
長出黴點，或邊角開始散開崩解
tips: 每天換水，這是最有效的一件事。
市場散裝豆腐當天煮再買。
煎之前先壓乾水分，豆腐才會上色而不是在鍋裡出水。
冷凍請切塊而不是整塊凍，解凍均勻也比較入味。

faq.q: 板豆腐放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 泡在乾淨冷水裡、每天換水，大約 2～3 天。市場散裝的最好當天吃完；盒裝未開封則看包裝上的日期。
可以，而且是刻意為之——這就是凍豆腐。壓乾、切塊後放 −18°C 冷凍。品質上大約五個月是合理參考，不過這是比照一般豆腐的時程，並非針對板豆腐公布的數字。

faq.q: 豆腐為什麼要泡在水裡？
faq.a: 水能維持豆腐的含水度，也隔絕空氣、保護切面。把水倒掉乾放，豆腐會更快發酸、表面龜裂。
新鮮豆腐一定要，而且建議 4°C 以下。常溫無菌包裝的盒豆腐是另一種產品，開封後才需要冷藏。
